parameters.name: ClientToken
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. The token must be unique across requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see How to ensure idempotence.

parameters.name: VirtualNodeId
parameters.description: A client token to ensure the idempotence of the request. Generate a token on your client to make sure that the token is unique across different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length. For more information, see [How to ensure idempotence](~~25693~~).
